name: Nanjou Ayame
source:
One of the original members of Team Revo.
She was approached by a senior member while livestreaming with her face visible, and joined in launching the team.

She has a gentle, easygoing personality.
Compared to Haruka, she seems more absent-minded.
She isn't very interested in other people, but she gets deeply absorbed in things she enjoys.
She’s easily influenced by others (quick to be swayed).
She has an extremely high sex drive—by far the highest among the four heroines.

At a certain after-party, she spotted Shian being hit on by an upperclassman.
Realizing what he was after, she stepped in to protect Shian and offered herself to him instead. Since then, she and the upperclassman have been friends with benefits.

She has virtually no romantic experience.
According to her, she “doesn’t like running out of time.”

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1210593/]Getchu[/url]]
